study type: pooled analysis of four Norwegian pregnancy cohorts
outcome: Sensitivity of FPG to predict elevated 2-hour glucose
Number of oral glucose tolerance tests (OGTTs) needed
cohort: Pregnant women from four Norwegian cohorts (2002-2013) who underwent universal screening with a late mid-pregnancy 75g OGTT measuring FPG and 2-hour glucose (n=2960).
finding: An FPG threshold of 4.7 mmol/L effectively ruled out the need for OGTT in 70-77% of pregnancies, with women below this threshold demonstrating a low risk of GDM-associated adverse pregnancy outcomes.
